invented.quote: To the Board of Trustees and Executive Director:
invented.why: The brief only says the letter is to the state employees' health plan and does not state that the plan is governed by a Board of Trustees or an Executive Director.

invented.quote: Each of those prescriptions loses money.
invented.why: The brief states that the plan pays on average $1.80 less per prescription across the 20 generic drugs, not that every single prescription among those 20 loses money.

invented.quote: No small business can keep doing a fifth of its work at a loss.
invented.why: The brief says plan members make up 22% of all prescriptions and that the 20 most-filled generics lose money on average, plus the user notes they make up part of the loss on brand-name drugs, so it is not supported that the entire 22% (a fifth of their work) is done at a loss.

invented.quote: But we do know that every pharmacy still open is now losing money on its most common plan prescriptions.
invented.why: The brief only provides cost and reimbursement figures for the 38 pharmacies in the alliance, not for every independent pharmacy still open in the state.

invented.quote: They are teachers, road crews, office staff and retirees.
invented.why: The brief does not specify the occupations or retirement status of the plan members.
